ctx.en: I don't want anyone to dislike me, so I end up trying to keep everybody happy.

ctx.s: 「あの人[ひと]、{八方美人[はっぽうびじん]}だから本音[ほんね]がわからないよね。」
ctx.en: "That person agrees with everyone, so you never know what they really think."

ctx.s: {八方美人[はっぽうびじん]}をやめたら、人間関係[にんげんかんけい]がずっと楽[らく]になった。
ctx.en: Once I stopped trying to please everybody, my relationships became much easier.

ctx.s: 全員[ぜんいん]の意見[いけん]に「そうですね」と答[こた]えていたら、{八方美人[はっぽうびじん]}だと陰口[かげぐち]を言[い]われた。
ctx.en: I kept answering "I see your point" to everyone, and people started saying behind my back that I just tell everyone what they want to hear.

ctx.s: 部長[ぶちょう]は{八方美人[はっぽうびじん]}な態度[たいど]で、対立[たいりつ]する両方[りょうほう]の部署[ぶしょ]に賛成[さんせい]してみせた。
ctx.en: Trying to keep everyone happy, the department head made a show of agreeing with both of the feuding departments.

bad.s: 彼女[かのじょ]は{八方美人[はっぽうびじん]}で、モデルみたいにきれいだ。
bad.en: (meant: she is beautiful from every angle, like a model)
bad.why: Despite the word bijin (beauty), today it never praises looks. It criticises someone who tries to please everyone.

bad.s: 誰[だれ]とでも仲良[なかよ]くできる{八方美人[はっぽうびじん]}な先輩[せんぱい]を尊敬[そんけい]している。
bad.en: (meant: I admire my senior, who gets along with everyone)
bad.why: It is a criticism, not praise for sociability. For someone genuinely liked by all, say dare kara mo sukareru.
